questions.question: The circumcentre of an equilateral triangle is at a distance of 3.2 cm from the base of the triangle. What is the length (in cm) of each of its altitudes?

In the quadrilateral AEPD

∠EAD + ∠PEA + ∠EPD + ∠PDA = 360º

⇒ ∠EPD = 360º - (66º + 90º + 90º)

∠EPD = 114º = ∠BPC

∠BQC = 90º + ∠BPCover 2

∠BQC = 90º + 114ºover 2 = 90º + 57º = 147º (since ∠EPD and ∠BPC are vertically opposite angles).

∴ , **The value of ∠BQC is 147º.**

questions.question: If a² + b² + 49c² + 18 = 2(b + 28c - a), then the value of (2a - b + 7c) is:
questions.solution:
Given data:

a2 + b2 + 49c2 + 18 = 2(b + 28c - a)

Formula Used:

1) (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

2) (a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab

Calculations:

According to question,

a2 + b2 + 49c2 + 18 = 2(b + 28c - a)

⇒ a2 + b2 + 49c2 + 18 = 2b + 56c -2a

⇒ a2 + b2 + 49c2 + 18 - 2b - 56c + 2a = 0

⇒ (a2 + 2a + 1 ) + (b2 - 2b + 1) + (7c)2 - 56c + 16 = 0

⇒ (a + 1)2 + (b - 1)2 + {(7c)2 - 56c + 42} = 0

⇒ (a + 1)2 + (b - 1)2 + (7c - 4)2 = 0 ----(1) (from formula 1 and 2)

Now In equation 1, In order it to be = 0 all the entities must be 0 

∴ (a + 1)2 = 0 

⇒ (a + 1) = 0

⇒ a = -1 ----(2)

Again,

(b - 1)2 = 0

⇒ (b - 1) = 0

⇒ b = 1 ----(3)

Again,

(7c - 4)2 = 0

⇒ (7c - 4) = 0

⇒ 7c = 4

 ⇒ c = 4over7 ----(4)

As per question,

(2a - b + 7c) = (2 × -1) - 1 + 7 × 4over7 

⇒ -2 - 1 + 4

⇒ 1

∴ The value of (2a - b + 7c) is 1.

questions.question:
If x² - 5x - 1 = 0, what is the value of 

frac{{{x⁶} - {x⁴} + {x²} - 1}}{{{x³}}}?
questions.solution:
**Calculations:**

Dividing equation (x2 - 5x - 1), both sides by x

⇒ x - 5 - 1over x= 0

⇒ x - 1over x = 5

 x³ - 1over x³ = (x - 1over x)³ + 3 × x × 1over x × (x - 1over x)

⇒ 5³ + 3 × 5 = 140

Seperating the fractions-

⇒ x⁶over x³ - x⁴over x³ + x²over x³ - 1over x³

⇒ x³ - x + 1over x - 1over x³

Rearranging the equation, we get-

⇒ ( x³ - 1over x³) - (x** **-** 1over x**)

Substituting the values, we get-

⇒ 140 - 5 = 135

∴ **The answer of the expression is 135.**

questions.question: Chords AB and CD of a circle intersect externally at P. If AB = 7 cm, CD = 1 cm and PD = 5 cm, then 50% of the length of PA (in cm) is:
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

AB = 7 cm

CD = 1 cm

PD = 5 cm

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e67eb472bdf2b59920e92a3b2a2a36f73ef411461d740965b078ef5121833f2.png] 

From the basic proportionality theorem,

PB × PA = PD × PC

Substituting the values-

⇒ PB × (7 + PB) = 5 × (5 + 1)

⇒ PB × (7 + PB) = 5 × 6 = 30

⇒ PB² + 7PB -30 = 0

⇒ PB2 + 10PB - 3PB -30 = 0

⇒ PB × (PB + 10) - 3 × (PB + 10) = 0

⇒ (PB - 3) × (PB + 10) = 0

Either PB = 3 or -10 (PB cannot be negative. Hence, PB = 3)

∴ PA = AB + BP = 7 + 3 = 10

Now,

⇒ 50% of PA = 50 × 10/100 = 5

∴ **The value of 50% PA is 5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** The equation PB × (7 + PB) = 30 could be solved by breaking 30 into appropriate factors to match the equation PB × (7 + PB).

⇒ 30 = 10 × 3 and 10 = 7 + 3

∴ 30 = 3 × (7 + 3)

⇒ PB × (7 + PB) = 3 × (7 + 3)

∴ PB = 3 cm and PA = 10 cm

⇒ 50% of PA = 50 × 10/100 = 5

∴ The value of 50% PA is 5 cm.

questions.question: Find a single discount percentage equivalent to successive discounts of 10%, 20% and 25%.
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

Discount (d₁) = 10%

Discount (d2) = 20%

Discount (d3) = 25%

**Formula Used:**

Effective discount = d₁ + d₂ - d₁ × d₂ over 100

Where “d₁” and “d₂” are successive discounts offered.

**Calculation:**

Effective discount = 10 + 20 - 10 × 20 over 100 = 30 - 2 = 28

Final discount = 28 + 25 - 25 × 28over 100 = 53 - 7 = 46

∴ **The final effective discount is 46%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Let the initial price be 100.

Price after 1st discount = 100 - 10 = Rs 90

Price after 2nd discount = 90 - 20 over 100 × 90 = 90 - 18 = 72

Price after 3rd discount = 72 - 25 over 100 × 72 = 72 - 18 = 54

Effective discount = 100 - 54 = 46%

∴ **The effective discount is 46%.**

questions.question: What is the LCM of 3.6, 1.8 and 0.144?
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

Number = 3.6, 1.8, and 0.144

**Calculation:**

Digit with highest digits after decimal = 0.144 

⇒ 3 digits after decimal i.e., n = 3 = 10³ 

⇒ 3.6 × 103 = 3600

⇒ 1.8 × 103 = 1800

⇒ 0.144 × 103 = 144

Finding the LCM of (3600, 1800, 144) = 3600

LCM = {3600over 10³}= 3.6

∴ **The LCM of the given numbers is 3.6.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**The LCM of 3.6, 1.8 and 0.144

LCM of (3.6, 1.8, 0.144)

⇒ LCM of (3600/1000, 1800/1000, 144/1000)

⇒ LCM of (3600/1000, 1800/1000, 144/1000) = (LCM of (3600, 1800, 144))/(HCF of (1000, 1000, 1000))

⇒ 3600/1000 = 3.6

∴ The LCM of the given numbers is 3.6.

questions.question: A and B had a joint business in which A invested Rs. 60,000 in the business for one year. After 3 months B invested Rs. 80,000. At the beginning of the second year, A invested Rs. 30,000 more and B withdrew Rs. 5,000. At the end of two years, profit earned by A is Rs. 35,880. What is the profit (in Rs.) earned by B, if they distributed half of the total profit equally and rest in the capital ratio?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total capital invested by A = 60,000 × 12 + 90,000 × 12 = 720,000 + 1,080,000 = Rs 1,800,000

Total capital invested by B = 80,000 × 9 + 75,000 × 12 = 720,000 + 900,000 = Rs 1,620,000

Ratio = 1,800,000 : 1,620,000 = 10 : 9

Let the total profit earned is 4p

Now, out of 4p profit, 2p is equally divided between A and B.

A's profit-

⇒ p + 10 over 19 × 2p = 35,880

⇒ 39p = 35,880 × 19

⇒ p = 35,880 × 19over 39 = Rs 17,480

Now,Profit earned by B = p + 9 over 19 × 2p = 37pover 19 = 37over 19 × 17,480

⇒ Profit of B = Rs 34,040.

**∴ The profit of B is Rs 34,040.**

questions.question: The average of three numbers is 15. The average of the second and the third number is 12.5. What is the first number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average of all 3 numbers = 15

Deviation of the 2nd and 3rd numbers from the total average = 12.5 − 15 = −2.5

Total deviation for these 2 numbers = −2.5 × 2 = −5

To balance the average, the 1st number must be +5 more than the total average.

First number = 15 + 5 = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of three numbers = 15

Average of the second and third number = 12.5

**Formula Used:**

Sum of given numbers = Average × Number of terms

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6cc5c93af478a10a9b4665d1078f9cf64a4ba42f7f6a6fc9009cea6b8f751c9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the three numbers be a, b, and c.

⇒ Average of a, b, and c = (a + b + c) ÷ 3 = 15

⇒ Sum of all three numbers (a + b + c) = 15 × 3 = 45

⇒ Average of b and c = (b + c) ÷ 2 = 12.5

⇒ Sum of the second and third number (b + c) = 12.5 × 2 = 25

⇒ Substitute the value of (b + c) in the first equation:

⇒ a + 25 = 45

⇒ a = 45 − 25

⇒ a = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combined Average

If the average of n₁ items is A₁ and n₂ items is A₂, then the combined average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Weighted Average

Used when different items have varying levels of importance or frequencies. Formula: Weighted Average = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + ...) ÷ (w₁ + w₂ + ...).

Average of Arithmetic Progression

For a set of numbers that form an Arithmetic Progression (equal difference between consecutive terms), the average is simply the middle term, calculated as (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2.

questions.question: If 8A5146B is divisible by 88, then what is the value of AB?
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

The divisibility rule of 8 states that for a number to be divisible by 8, its last three-digit should be perfectly divisible by 8.

The divisibility rule of 11 states that for a number to be divisible by 11, the difference between the sum of odd and even digits should be completely divisible by 11. 

**Calculations:**

Using Divisibility rule of 8, we get-

∴ 46B is completely divisible by 8 if B is 4. (∴ B = 4)

Similarly using divisibility rule of 11, we get-

⇒ (8 + 5 + 4 + 4) - (A + 1 + 6) = 21 - 7 - A = 14 - A 

⇒ The number is perfectly divisible if A = 3 (∴ A = 3)

∴ value of AB = 3⁴ = 81

**The value of AB is 81.**

questions.question: X, Y and Z can complete a piece of work in 46 days, 92 days and 23 days, respectively. X started the work. Y joined him after 7 days. If Z joined them after 8 days from the beginning, then for how many days did Y work?
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

Days in which X can complete the work = 46 days

Days in which Y can complete the work = 92 days

Days in which Z can complete the work = 23 days

Days after which Y joined = 7 days

Days after which Z joined = 8 days

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Total work / Time taken to complete work individually

**Calculation:**

LCM of 23, 46, 92 = 92

Assuming that the total work is 92 units.

Efficiency of x-

⇒ 92over 46 = 2 units of work/day

Efficiency of y-

⇒ 92over 92 = 1 unit of work/day

Efficiency of z-

⇒ 92over 23 = 4 units of work/day

Work done in 7 days by X working alone = 2 units × 7 = 14 units

Work done by X and Y on 8th day = (2 + 1) × 1 = 3 units

Total work done until 8th day = 14 + 3 = 17 units

Remaining work = 92 - 17 = 75 units

Work done by X , Y and Z in one day = 2 + 1 + 4 = 7 units

Total time taken = 75over 7 days

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let the total work be 92 units.
